release_context.omission_reason: The first release has no prior release artifact to restore; it may only prove human-approved uninstall/disable recovery to the prior non-plugin configuration.

validator_rule.required_action: rollback gate must have one evidence object per listed matrix cell
validator_rule.omission_condition: release_version != null AND release_version < required_from_release AND omission_allowed_before_release == true

gates.omission_reason: No previous release artifact exists for release 1; only uninstall/disable recovery may be validated.
A first release must prove recovery to the prior non-plugin Hermes configuration by uninstalling or disabling the plugin.

cells.encoding: UTF-8 RFC 8785/JCS JSON array of arrays in tuple_order, no trailing newline
cells.reason: No release manifest or implementation exists; applicable matrix cells are not yet recorded.

matrix.uniqueness: each tuple appears exactly once; stable cell id is SHA-256 of the UTF-8 JCS tuple array [python, platform, artifact_variant]
matrix.applicability: include a tuple only when its artifact variant is declared applicable for that exact Python/platform pair; do not infer missing tuples by Cartesian expansion
matrix.cardinality: count(the ordered tuple array at source)
matrix.evidence_rule: each required gate has exactly one evidence object per listed cell; no evidence is valid while cells.state is BLOCKED; optional gates are BLOCKED or omitted only under release_context.validator_rule and the gate's omission fields
matrix.artifact_reuse: an immutable artifact hash may occur in multiple explicitly listed cells, but each cell requires independent run-scoped evidence

id_rules.assertion_order: assertions array order per gate is normative
id_rules.matrix_cell_id: SHA-256 of UTF-8 RFC 8785/JCS encoding of the ordered tuple array [python, platform, artifact_variant], lowercase hex
id_rules.evidence_id: unique per observation; never reused across gates, cells, or reruns

evidence_rules.blocked_requires: non-empty blocker and no promotion to PASS
evidence_rules.observed_assertions: exactly the expected assertion IDs, once each, in catalog order

redaction_map.encoding: UTF-8 RFC 8785/JCS with the hash field omitted
redaction_map.command_id: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JCS object {argv: command.argv, tool_versions: command.tool_versions, redaction_map_sha256: command.redaction_map.hash}; command.argv is the canonical recorded/redacted argv and placeholders are bound by redaction_map entries
redaction_map.independent_validation: reproducible without access to the unrevealed argv or any secret

evidence_rules.deterministic_reuse: output reuse is forbidden unless reuse_of is present; reuse_of is the sole exception and must identify the original run/output and prove immutable content-addressed output plus exactly matching complete provenance
evidence_rules.activation_assertion: execute variables plugin_name and plugin_version from the verified manifest; reject each unless it is one safe path component matching [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]* and not . or ..; assert readlink(active) equals expected_rel and readlink -f(active) equals realpath -e(expected_rel), then import/register through active
